issues.detail: The Hebrew phrase 'לְכָל רֽוּחַ' means 'to every wind' (i.e., scatter to all directions), but the Chinese renders it as '到一切靈那裏' ('to every spirit'), which changes the meaning from a physical scattering to the winds to a spiritual destination. This is a mistranslation of 'רוּחַ' (wind) as '靈' (spirit).
